items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Frank Vignola, great guitarist, I work a lot with him, we’re great friends and do a lot of musical business work together. We were doing a gig, a trio or quartet at Elaine’s.

ctx.x: Yeah, very cool. I did a gig at a place on 89th Street in New York called Elaine’s, that’s some posh upper east side place. Frank Vignola, great guitarist, I work a lot with him, we’re great friends and do a lot of musical business work together. We were doing a gig, a trio or quartet at Elaine’s. I was playing just brushes on a small kit. And in New York people are always coming in and out. So one night Fagan was there. Okay?
